title: Man and Elderly Woman Outside House, 1963 Snapshot Black & White
description: A candid black-and-white square snapshot from January 1963 depicting a man standing alongside an elderly woman outside a suburban home. The woman stands on a concrete step by a sliding glass door, affectionately placing her arm around the man's shoulder. A wooden fence and patio area frame the background, exemplifying post-war American residential lifestyle. The photo border features the original photo lab processing date stamp 'JAN 63'.
